name: Public site runtime
purpose: Keeps the public portfolio contact and observability runtime configurable without hardcoded endpoints.
safety: Public values must never include service-role keys; contact fallback remains available when unset.

name: Supabase intake dual-write
purpose: Enables server-side brief persistence while preserving the local JSONL fallback path.
safety: Service role key is server-only and must be stored only in the deployment platform secret manager.

name: Retention cleanup cron
purpose: Protects the 90-day retention policy for stored brief submissions.
safety: Cron endpoint rejects requests without the bearer secret.

name: GitHub source persistence
purpose: Keeps the active Codex branch recoverable on the GitHub server.
safety: Pushes remain bounded, non-interactive and branch-scoped.
setupCommand: npm run github:preflight && npm run github:publish

name: Vercel deployment
purpose: Deploys the Next.js portfolio to Vercel preview or production once credentials are available.
safety: Deploy commands require explicit target confirmation and must not write tokens into git.

name: Custom server static fallback
purpose: Publishes the static fallback to a selected server after host, user and path are confirmed.
safety: Dry-run is mandatory before live rsync; no upload runs without concrete credentials.
